title: Xanadu labor code amendment draft released for public comment
content: The Ministry of Human Resources released the draft Labor Code Amendment for a 30-day public consultation.

title: XNSO announces updated social insurance contribution schedule
content: XNSO published the updated contribution schedule for 2027 as required under the Social Insurance Act.

title: XNSO releases Q1 2027 social insurance contribution rates
content: XNSO officially released contribution rates for Q1 2027, showing increases for both employee and employer portions.

title: XNSO circular: updated contribution table published
content: XNSO published the updated contribution table for 2027.

title: Payroll compliance deadline extended to end of quarter
content: XNSO extended the payroll compliance reporting deadline.

title: Employment contract registration portal maintenance announced
content: XNSO announced scheduled maintenance for the employment contract registration portal.
